Maya (People Ops): Hi all 12 planning to start parental leave on Tue Jul 12. I'm also doing a short international move the week before. Quick Q: what paperwork does payroll need so the Redwood parental top-up and tax withholding are correct?

People Ops Bot: Submit the leave via https://hr.redwood.com/leave and attach supporting docs (birth/adoption cert, FMLA eligibility if applicable). For international changes, include passport/visa and new address proof.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks. How far in advance for payroll cutoff?

Finance (Payroll): For top-up to apply on first affected pay run we need all docs uploaded at least 8 business days before your first day of leave. If your move changes tax residency, allow extra time for withholding updates and cc finance-relocation@redwood.com.

Nina (Mgr): I can cover the on-call rotation and take the scheduled interviews. Maya, can you drop a 1-paragraph handoff note and update runbook links?

Maya (People Ops): Will do. Also want to keep one async weekly check-in; is that allowed?

People Ops Bot: Limited check-ins are permitted with manager sign-off. Set "Limited availability" on the leave form and note preferred windows.

IT Support: If you need a temporary loaner while abroad, file a ticket at it-support@redwood.com. Shipping timelines vary by country.

Maya (People Ops): Uploading docs now and will send the handoff by EOD. Appreciate the quick answers :heart:
